tea: A hot drink made by infusing the leaves of the tea plant in water.
eat: To take food into the mouth, chew it, and swallow it.
rat: A small rodent with a long tail.
tap: To strike lightly, or a device that controls the flow of liquid from a pipe.
seat: A place designed for one person to sit.
stone: A hard, naturally occurring piece of rock.
tone: A sound or the quality of a sound.
son: A male child in relation to a parent.
not: Used to express negation or denial.
toe: One of the digits of the foot.
tan: A yellowish-brown color; to brown skin in the sun; to convert hide into leather.
car: A road vehicle with an engine, usually four wheels, for carrying passengers.
art: The expression of human creative skill and imagination.
rate: A measure, quantity, or frequency; to assign a score or rank.
care: The provision of what is necessary for health, welfare, or protection; to feel concern.
tear: A drop of clear liquid from the eye; to pull apart by force.
race: A competition of speed; a group of people sharing distinctive physical traits.
acre: A unit of land area equal to 4,840 square yards.
plate: A flat dish for food; a flat sheet of metal or other material.
late: Doing something or occurring after the expected time.
tale: A story, especially one that is imaginary or invented.
east: The direction toward the point of the horizon where the sun rises.
set: To put in a specified position; a group of things that belong together.
net: A mesh fabric used for catching or trapping; remaining after deductions.
pet: A domestic or tamed animal kept for companionship.
pat: To touch or stroke gently; a light tap.
ape: A large primate without a tail; to imitate.
age: The length of time a person or thing has existed.
era: A long and distinct period of history.
gear: Equipment or apparatus; a toothed wheel that works with others.
sea: The expanse of salt water covering most of the earth.
last: Coming after all others; to continue over time.
her: Belonging to or associated with a female person.
the: Denoting one or more people or things already mentioned.
here: In, at, or to this place or position.
tree: A woody perennial plant with a trunk and branches.
there: In, at, or to that place.
den: A wild animal's lair; a small room for retreat.
due: Expected at a certain time; owed.
red: Of the color of blood or fire.
run: To move at a speed faster than a walk.
